title: High-Precision Approximation of Riemann Zeros via the Truncated Weil Form
summary: The Connes-van Suijlekom truncated Weil quadratic form, indexed by a cutoff $c$ (controlling the primes $p\leq c$ in the operator), has a ground state whose Fourier-Mellin zeros provably lie on the critical line; whether they converge to the Riemann zeros as $c\to\infty$ is open (Connes 2026; Connes-Consani-Moscovici 2025). We present, to our knowledge, the first public implementation of the CvS Galerkin matrix at sixteen cutoffs ($c=13$ through $67$, plus $c=100$).
